name: Long Way Home
source:
Takeshi (default name) has decided to return home due to several reasons, among them being his new job which he desperately needs. At first it would appear that everything is going as planned, but reality soon hits and says otherwise. Takeshi is trying to dodge a darker side of his past, but will he manage?

With his new job comes an old place that appears new after so much time away, and with it new people... both friends and not so friendly people. On the surface a city that is ideal for young people looking for love and career., but it turns out that everyone has a secret or two on their own... some darker than others.

As Takeshi finds himself involved in all of this, question remains, how does he get out of it all?

[From Itch.io]
translation:
出于种种原因，Takeshi（默认名）决定返回家乡，其中之一便是他急需的那份新工作。起初，一切似乎都在按计划进行，可现实很快就告诉他并非如此。Takeshi试图逃避过去阴暗的一面，但他能成功吗？

新工作所在的，仍是那个熟悉的地方，只是阔别太久，一切又显得陌生。他也将认识新的人…其中有朋友，也有不那么友善的家伙。表面上，这是一座适合年轻人追求爱情、发展事业的理想城市，可实际上，每个人都藏着一两个秘密…有些比其他人的更加黑暗。

当Takeshi卷入这一切时，问题仍然是：他究竟该如何脱身？
